summary: Re-review after merging main (PRs 178 and 181: structured problems, agent without a GPU). The changed paths against the new merge-base are exactly this PR's own; the merge touched only CHANGELOG (v0.41.1 row above v0.41.0/v0.40.0, agent column 0.36.0), VERSION 0.36.1, the regenerated ADR index (0101-0104 consecutive) and one row of the backup table in operations EN+DE that now names SECRET_FILE as the source with SECRET_SOURCE=file. Re-checked after the merge that the router still gates paho with find_spec (ha.py) and creates the MQTT publisher only with mqtt.host (app.py), and that no merged module reads secrets.env, render-env or MQTT_PASSWORD differently. Substance unchanged from the first review: render-env.sh no longer stops at a missing MQTT_PASSWORD; the access file is still sourced only after not_router_writable; the store is used only after an explicit login step whose HTTP status is reported; every name keeps the ADR-0080 rule; every value is refused on CR/LF; the file is written through mktemp in the target folder, group skirnir-router 0640 (0600 without the account) and an atomic rename; a failed fetch or a source with none of the names keeps the existing file. SECRET_SOURCE=file: SECRET_FILE passes not_router_writable, must be a regular file readable by root only, and is parsed with bash read, never sourced or evaluated. The bearer token goes to curl via stdin instead of argv (TM-15). install.sh --without-mqtt removes only python3-paho-mqtt and passes --without paho-mqtt to pydeps.py, which can only leave out requirements and refuses unknown names; hash-locked installation unchanged (TM-16). Added text names no organisation, host, address or person.

limitations: The store client was exercised against a fake store only; that the store answers a missing secret with HTTP 404 is assumed from its API. Any other status is treated as a failed fetch, keeps the existing file and is logged by name and status.
Pre-existing, both sources: a value ending in a backslash makes systemd's EnvironmentFile parser join the next line; that can lose the following key but cannot add a name. Not changed here.
As for the access file, only the file and its own folder are checked for owner and mode, not the folders above SECRET_FILE.
monitoring/render-monitoring.sh is unchanged (it never had the MQTT gate) and still treats a failed fetch like a missing name, which keeps its old file in both cases.
No real systemd, apt or venv run: install.sh was tested in its staging mode (--root, --no-venv); pydeps --without is covered by unit cases.
The code merged from main (PRs 178 and 181) was reviewed in their own records and is outside this record's change set; only its interaction with MQTT and secrets handling was re-checked here.
